description_en: Call the UpdateDcdnDeliverTask operation to update a subscribed report task by its tracking task ID

kebab_example: aliyun dcdn update-dcdn-deliver-task --deliver-id 92 --name Domain_subscription --reports reportId_:2,_conditions_:_field_:_prov_,_op_:_in_,_value_:_Heilongjiang_,_Beijing --domain-name www.example.com --deliver email_:_subject_:_topic_name_,_to_:_username@example.com_,_username@example.com --schedule schedName_:_subscription_task_name_,_description_:_description_,_crontab_:_000000_,_frequency_:_d_,_status_:_enable_,_effectiveFrom_:_2020-09-17T00:00:00Z_,_effectiveEnd_:_2020-11-17T00:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en: A list of reports to subscribe to. The value must be a JSON-escaped string.
